relationships.subject: emodin
relationships.evidence_quote: administration of pioglitazone (10 mg/kg) and emodin (50 mg/kg) significantly delayed the onset of mechanical hyperalgesia in rats with CCI (P < 0.001)

relationships.subject: emodin
relationships.evidence_quote: the pretreatment of emodin alleviates the behavioral alterations associated with pain sensitivity; and suppress the inflammatory mediators TNF-α, COX-2 and NF-kB triggered by NP caused by chronic constrictive injury

key_findings: Emodin reduced CCI-induced pain behaviour, oxidative stress and COX-2, TNF-alpha and p-NFkB while restoring PPAR-gamma in rat sciatic nerve and spinal cord.
The PPAR-gamma antagonist GW9662 reversed emodin's effects, implicating the PPAR-gamma pathway.
